acceptance: tpch_skew manifests at SF 0.01 and 0.1 carry row counts equal to the generated files' non-empty line counts and `row_counts_source: measured` (unit test).
A table of all 11 ADR benchmarks states whether each manifest has measured counts; any other gap has a tracker item.
context: datagen-lib-synthetic-tpch-skew must record measured counts natively.
description:
## Problem
tpch_skew's data manifest carries estimated row counts without `row_counts_source: measured` (SF 0.01: 86,612 in the manifest against 86,805 rows generated and converted). Conversion therefore validates against counted source lines instead of the manifest, and any consumer reading the manifest gets wrong counts.

## Change
Make the tpch_skew generator record measured per-table row counts and `row_counts_source: measured`, as TPC-H does; check the other generators for the same gap and list them.

## Decision gates
- If measured counts differ from documented expected counts for the benchmark, report rather than editing expectations.

## Guardrails
- BenchBox work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, make agent-write-preflight); the primary clone is read-only.
- Heavy work only through make heavy-run; never bypass or signal the lock, and never kill processes by name pattern (pkill -f); stop only PIDs you started.
- Commits as the configured human identity; no agent attribution.
- A choice between a small and a large implementation path goes to the owner with sizes before work starts.
- Report only results that were observed; name anything not run.
